title: Algebraic-closure internal Hom comparison from finite-field continuity
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, let $E\subseteq\Omega$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $X$ be a scheme. Put $S=p_X^*\underline E$ and $T=p_X^*\underline\Omega$ on the small pro-étale site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the module universe and small-site convention [def-weil-size-convention], the ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves and ambient relative internal Hom and tensor [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. For $M\in D(S)$ write $M_\Omega=T\otimes_S^L M$. Suppose $K\in D(S)$ has the following internal-sheaf continuity property: for every small filtered diagram $(M_i^\bullet)$ of $S$-module complexes with one common termwise lower bound, the evaluation comparison $\varinjlim_i R\mathcal Hom_S(K,M_i^\bullet)\to R\mathcal Hom_S(K,\varinjlim_iM_i^\bullet)$ is an isomorphism. Colimits here are exact termwise sheaf-module colimits of functorial representatives [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $L\in D(S)$ be bounded below in cohomology.

The canonical evaluation-transpose comparison
$$T\otimes_S^L R\mathcal Hom_S(K,L)\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_T(K_\Omega,L_\Omega)$$
is an isomorphism, natural in $K,L$. Specifically, finite intermediate fields $E\subseteq F\subseteq\Omega$ form a small filtered cofinal subposet of the finite subextensions of $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$; their coefficient sheaves $F_X$ are finite free over $S$, and their sheaf-algebra colimit is $T$. After restriction to $D(S)$, the displayed map is the composite
$$T\otimes_S^L R\mathcal Hom_S(K,L)\simeq\varinjlim_F(F_X\otimes_S R\mathcal Hom_S(K,L))\simeq\varinjlim_F R\mathcal Hom_S(K,F_X\otimes_SL)\simeq R\mathcal Hom_S(K,T\otimes_SL).$$
The stage maps are induced by evaluation, commute with all field-inclusion transitions, and are independent of choices of finite bases. No constructibility, site-perfectness or completeness of $K,L$ is assumed beyond the displayed continuity and lower-bound hypotheses.

proof.text: For the proved auxiliary clauses, naturality is the existing native scalar-Hom naturality after unfolding its identical evaluation transpose. The restriction equation is the generic uniqueness-of-right-adjoints mate identity. The small field tail is filtered and final by the existing finite-subextension order; its finite-free assertion follows directly from [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients]. Extension of the regular module is identified with the target regular module by the bimodule right unitor, retaining its multiplication equation; naturality of mixedScalarMap gives the actual field and closure legs. Finally restrict [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x] along the final field functor to prove coefficientRingColimit.

For coefficient_comparison_roof, choose the normalized scalar Hom models and their adjunction from lem-sfb-dc-hom-scalar-adjunction. Apply homPresentation_nonempty and internal_section_hom_continuity_comparison to the prescribed models over both section rings. Their evaluation equations are precisely HomTransportNormalized; their ordinary and derived restriction comparisons give the section identity and the recorded localization normalization. Apply the normalized adjunction-transport equation to the identity of scalar extension of K. Expanding the two Hom transposes and cancelling the image of the inverse extension comparison proves the required unit equation. The hom field is the stated native comparison equation, since both comparison definitions are the same evaluation transpose. Attach the existing evaluationRoof witness.

Use fieldDiagram and coefficientModules directly for the filtered small index and the stage identifications. Convert the finite internal biproduct of regular modules to a coproduct, transport it by finite_free_iff, and identify its finite coproduct with the finite product required by the strict filtered-Hom theorem. For the specified coefficient cocone, apply nonempty_isColimit_coefficientComplexCocone to the regular E-module concentrated in degree zero and to the final field-tail functor. The section equivalence on complexes and degree-zero evaluation preserve this colimit; their image cocone is definitionally coefficientCocone. This avoids the larger finite-free algebra-presentation package and a separate sectionwise module-colimit reconstruction.

Unfold the supplied continuity hypothesis on the representative P. Apply the proved generic strictColimitFormula_of_finiteFree to the finite-free coefficient diagram and its prescribed colimit cocone. It supplies all eleven clauses of StrictColimitFormula, including evaluation normalization, both colimit squares, the separate Hom postcomparison, and the stage and vertex quasi-isomorphisms. The generic assembly is compiled as a separate proved support module; no additional unproved statement is introduced.

Choose a K-flat resolution of a complex representing the section image of K, retaining its termwise flatness, and a bounded-below complex representing the section image of L. The latter exists by the transported cohomological lower bound. Apply coefficient_colimit_formula. coefficientModules, the ordinary restriction comparison r, and the section-unit isomorphism identify the cocone vertex with the restricted regular closure module. Naturality of the strict numerator transports its quasi-isomorphism to this coefficient module. Compose the ordinary scalar adjunction with the two section equivalences. The already-given ordinary restriction isomorphism identifies its right adjoint with ordinary scalar restriction; uniqueness of left adjoints then transports exactness of native scalar extension to the scalar model used in coefficient_comparison_roof.

In the evaluation roof, exact scalar extension makes every representative-comparison map invertible, hence also sourceMap and targetMap. The denominator is a quasi-isomorphism by the stated K-flat and termwise-flat hypotheses. The roof equation and the vertex numerator quasi-isomorphism show that restrictedComparison is invertible for the chosen representatives. Its naturality transports this result to the given derived inputs. Conservative scalar restriction then gives invertibility of the ringed-site evaluation transpose. The final equation of coefficient_comparison_roof and the section equivalence reflect this invertibility back to evaluationComparison. Only the chosen representative of L is bounded below; no bound on internal Hom is used.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2(2), Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15 motivate the coefficient passage; the conditional continuity assertion is an agent formulation. Preserve the existing F6 auxiliary proofs and U4 evaluation-roof assembly. P4 proves the two remaining clauses by specializing the existing strict finite-free filtered-Hom theorem, using the already-proved canonical coefficient-complex colimit rather than the larger algebra-presentation package, and then combining the normalized evaluation roof with representative isomorphisms and conservative restriction. Generic K-flat resolutions and tensor-colimit preservation are categorical tools; the restricted-Hom route of the unit is retained. The proved generic strict-cocone assembly is factored into lem-sfb-strict-finite-free-hom-colimit-formula; all existing public declarations and definitions of this item are retained. The unchanged coefficient data and existing normalized roof are checked separately in QlbarInternalHomCoefficientData and publicly re-exported by the item.
